scope: Eight unselected Books 10–16 lessons; full automated validation with targeted owner, target-grammar and sampled bilingual/assessment review
automatedCoverage: Fresh build and --check pass 8 lessons, 48 questions, 32 audio requests, zero structural flags. All eight exact source examples match their case-insensitive target regex, all speaking target spans extract the taught form, and no selected lesson ID collides. Of 192 learner-facing English strings screened against 2,604 source examples, one six-word overlap is the fixed carrier 'is part of the furniture in' in a distinct setting; no copied non-target source clause found.
riskBasedManualReview: Sampled four-valid replies, keyed scenes, changed writing contexts and EN/ZH meaning in all eight. 3978 distinguishes a fresh start from a cosmetic change while preserving actual past misconduct; 3986 mental skill development and 3997 maintenance of an existing skill are semantically distinct. The two target detectors nevertheless omit ordinary inflections advertised by the reusable grammar and task goal.

findings.issue: The detector matches only base 'sharpen the mind'. It rejects ordinary grammatical 'sharpens the mind', 'sharpened the mind' and 'sharpening the mind', so a learner using the target naturally in another tense/aspect would not be detected.
findings.recommendedRepair: Boundedly include subject/tense inflections for sharpen, test source and assessed positive forms plus unrelated negative forms, and preserve the figurative mental-skill sense. Add one assessed non-base form if needed to make the reusable grammar visible.

findings.issue: The detector matches only 'stay sharp' although brief.grammar itself says 'a person stays sharp'. It rejects ordinary 'stays sharp', 'stayed sharp' and 'staying sharp'.
findings.recommendedRepair: Boundedly include these stay inflections and check live positives/negatives; retain the existing-skill maintenance boundary versus 3986's development sense.

manualReviewLimit: All eight lessons received automated source/target/span/structure/originality checks. Manual review was risk-based, not a fresh line-by-line translation audit of every question. This is AI-only editorial review, with no manifest or release approval.
